families.title: Failure of the exponential Rényi-increment threshold below one
families.scope: For every real 0<p<1 there exists a finite normalized truncated exponential whose iid positive-sum Rényi entropy increment strictly exceeds the exponential increment. Consequently no threshold p0 in (0,1) has the proposed exponential-maximizer property above p0.

families.one_family: One threshold refutation; every-order strengthening, DCT mechanism and all formal helpers uncredited separately. No Shannon p=1, actual optimizer, cube or uniform-cutoff result claimed.
